releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.16.0 — Nokiatis Cloud, and an updater that finally works.

THE BIG ONE
• Nokiatis Cloud (optional account): sign in from Settings → Cloud with a free email + password account and your whole library — likes, saves, playlists, history, bookmarks, follows, listening stats — syncs itself across every device. Merging is a true union (nothing duplicates), deletions always win, and your first sync uploads your existing library exactly as it is.
• Still 100% local-first: every feature works with no account and no network. Signing out never touches your local data.

FIXED — the updater itself
• The bug that made updates silently claim "You're on the latest version" is fixed. The feed is published in a dual shape every app version can read, and the app verifies size, SHA-256, package, version and both certificates before anything is installed. A tampered file is deleted automatically.

NEW
• Beta channel: opt in from Settings → Updates. Betas never lock the app and can always be skipped — a newer build is always offered again.
• Cloud screen in Settings: sign up / sign in / sync now / auto-sync toggle / use my cloud settings on this phone / change password / delete cloud copy.

ALWAYS
• Installs over your current version with the same Team Nokiatis signature — every song, playlist, download, stat and setting stays exactly where it is.
• 174 automated core checks passed before this build shipped.
